acceptance: `evolve bridge promote-rule` with a regex that matches no corpus line writes the rule at stage shadow (red: unknown subcommand)
A regex that matches a healthy-pane corpus line is refused with exit 1 naming the line
fix: Add `evolve bridge promote-rule --regex R --response-keys K --corpus F [--note T]`. It calls PromoteRule with the rules directory add-rule uses and the corpus file's lines, and prints the promoted rule's id and path, or the corpus line that refuted it. Exit 0 promoted, 1 refused by the corpus, 10 usage. Document it next to add-rule in runtime-reference.md.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: `evolve bridge add-rule` writes an auto-responder rule without checking it (cmd_bridge.go:114). interaction.PromoteRule refuses a regex that matches any line of a healthy-pane corpus, so a rule cannot fire on normal output, and writes the rule at stage shadow (internal/interaction/rulepromote.go:77). Only tests call it, so a rule learned from a stall is added unchecked or not at all.
title: Promoting a learned auto-responder rule after checking it against the healthy-pane corpus is unreachable; add `evolve bridge promote-rule`
